events.title: The July apparition at Fátima
events.shortBlurb: In the third Fátima apparition Our Lady showed the three children a vision and entrusted them a secret…
body: On 13 July 1917 the Blessed Virgin appeared for the third time to the shepherd children Lucia dos Santos and her cousins Francisco and Jacinta Marto at the Cova da Iria near Fatima, Portugal. In Lucia's account the children were shown a momentary vision of hell, a sea of fire in which demons and the souls of sinners suffer.

"You have seen hell where the souls of poor sinners go," Our Lady told them. "To save them, God wishes to establish in the world devotion to my Immaculate Heart." She foretold a worse war under Pius XI if men did not cease offending God, and promised to return and ask the consecration of Russia to her Immaculate Heart and the Communion of reparation on the first Saturdays.

These words, with a further vision, form the secret of Fatima in three parts, which Lucia committed to writing only in 1941 and 1944; the third part was published by the Holy See in 2000. The apparitions continued on the thirteenth of each month until October, when the promised sign was witnessed by a vast crowd.

sources.text: Vatican account, The Message of Fátima (vatican.va)
